rule: An overlay is never selected by filename/version alone. Official root schema remains the default when an official release exists. Candidate/integration overlays require explicit authority/profile selection and are assembled into an isolated temporary schema pool.

overlays.assembly_rule: Copy the selected official dependency pool into an isolated validation workspace, then replace only IBIS-IP_common_V2.3.xsd with the overlay bytes. Do not mutate repository root files and do not apply latest-wins dependency substitution.
